title: Name Vetting Fee on OV and EV Certificates
content:
# Validation team fee schedule: name vetting on OV and EV certificates

An added name on an OV or EV product of SSL/TLS Certificates must be approved under the organisation validation, and its added-name charge carries a name vetting fee. The fee follows the age of the subscription's organisation validation, counted in calendar days from the date organisation validation last completed to today. An added name on a DV product carries no name vetting fee.

## Schedule

| Product | Organisation validation reuse period | Name vetting fee per added name |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 0 days (none performed) | none |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 0 days (none performed) | none |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 0 days (none performed) | none |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 398 days | 9.00 or 25.00, by age |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 398 days | 9.00 or 25.00, by age |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 398 days | 9.00 or 25.00, by age |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 398 days | 9.00 or 25.00, by age |

For an OV or EV product:

- organisation validation completed **no more than 398 days** before today: the name vetting fee is **9.00**;
- organisation validation completed **more than 398 days** before today: the name vetting fee is **25.00**.

## Either side of the limit

| Days from the last organisation validation to today | Fee on an OV or EV product |
|---|---|
| 397 | 9.00 |
| 398 | 9.00 |
| 399 | 25.00 |

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical Harborline EV Multi-Domain subscription last completed organisation validation 2 March 2032. A name added on 4 April 2033 comes 398 days after that date, so it carries 9.00; a name added the following day carries 25.00. A name added on a Harborline DV Multi-Domain subscription on any date carries no name vetting fee.
